info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Facility By Param1-spec
info.description: The Update Facility Information API is designed to enable the modification of existing facility data based on specific parameters. This API allows users to adjust details of facilities within the utilities administration sector, enhancing their operational flexibility. Typical consumers include facility managers and administrative personnel who require up-to-date information for compliance and management purposes. By utilizing this endpoint, users can efficiently implement changes to facility profiles, ensuring accurate and current data handling.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of the utility administration resource identified by RES-100045. Ensure that you specify the fields that need to be updated in your request.

requestBody.description: Updates the specified facility's utilities administration data. This request may include modifications to various fields within the facility's operation details.

200.description: The request was successfully processed and the resource has been updated.
